name: AddDollarFormat
meaning: Formats a number as a US dollar string: rounds the absolute value to two decimals, adds thousands separators (up to 9 integer digits), always shows two decimal places, and puts a "-" before the "$" for negatives.
open_question: Supports at most 9 integer digits; larger amounts are output without separators. Negative sign is before the "$".

name: Triggers.AreAllowed
meaning: Returns true unless the global $$disableOnLoadEvents is true: the expression is $$disableOnLoadEvents = False.
open_question: Hidden global $$disableOnLoadEvents; an unset variable evaluates as empty = False, which is true.

name: Triggers.Disable
meaning: Sets the global $$disableOnLoadEvents to True (turning off on-load trigger work) and returns an empty string.

name: Triggers.Enable
meaning: Sets the global $$disableOnLoadEvents to False (turning on-load trigger work back on) and returns an empty string.

name: AddRemoveListItems
meaning: Toggles items in a return-separated list: for each value in theValues, adds it if absent, removes it if present (case-insensitive via FilterValues). Empty lines and leading/trailing returns are always removed. With a list of values it recurses through them in order.
open_question: Third-party function (Bruce Robertson, based on David Head's).  Byte-identical body in: Picker Module.fmp12#8.
